note: The single home of terrain semantics (place design A1.3). The LDtk IntGrid value list must equal this file; the bake checks it. z: draw order, low first, unique. T: the exploration tile the terrain becomes in lay.tiles. earth (the heart's clearing, the art desk's pairs grass-earth and sand-earth) is the lowest ground of both its pairs, so its z sits below sand's and grass's. The open edges (mibi-art abb33a65b, order low to high: deep, water, earth, sand, mud, path, grass, scrub, thicket, cliff): cliff is raised land, its top is ground you can walk, every cliff cell with a non-cliff cell next to it (4-neighbour) is the lip or the face and blocks except the cells under a WayUp area; thicket blocks; scrub is low and walks like grass. The biome grounds (the art director's signed skins, mibi-art art/desk 8c0ddc470) are patches of ground over grass that walk like grass: leaf litter (Woods, Tallwood), dry grass (Thickets), short turf (Hills); scree (the rock field, Cliffs and Highpools) walks like sand. They sit above grass and below scrub, thicket and cliff.
